name: Perris Towne Square
demographics: Perris Towne Square serves a diverse, family-oriented community in the Inland Empire with a predominantly middle-income demographic. The trade area attracts value-conscious shoppers seeking everyday necessities and convenience, with household compositions skewing toward families with children. Primary visitors include working-class residents from Perris and surrounding communities who prioritize accessibility and practical shopping options. The center caters to a multicultural customer base with shopping patterns focused on grocery, essential retail, and family dining needs.
description: Perris Towne Square is a community shopping destination located at 47 West Nuevo Road in Perris, California, serving the growing Inland Empire region. This open-air shopping center has established itself as a convenient hub for local residents, offering a practical mix of retail, dining, and service options that cater to everyday needs. With operating hours from 8:30 AM to 10:00 PM, the center provides extended accessibility for busy families and working professionals throughout the week. The shopping center has earned a solid reputation among visitors, maintaining a 4.2-star rating from over 1,750 reviews, reflecting its consistent service and community value. Strategically positioned in Perris, the center serves as an important retail anchor for the surrounding neighborhoods, providing essential shopping and dining options in a welcoming, accessible environment that continues to meet the evolving needs of the local community.
